moworks.notes: A soft radial light (stops rgba(255,214,140,.95) -> rgba(255,140,80,.45) at 50 % -> transparent, radius 200 on a 320 frame, y 40 %) sweeps left -> right (centre x -120 -> W + 120) easeInOutSine over 800 ms with opacity sin(pi p): builds 0-400 ms, the cut happens at 400 ms under the peak, fades 400-800 ms. Params: duration (0.8 s) · color (cam ấm) · peak (0.95). Called with the cut time: the leak starts half its duration before it.
